summary: The registrant (Energy 11, L.P.) filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its regular monthly and one-time special cash distributions. In December 2025, the Board approved a 2026 distribution schedule. Through April 2026, the Partnership paid $0.46/unit (~$8.7M) in monthly distributions. In May, a $0.12/unit monthly distribution was declared (payable June 3, 2026). The General Partner also approved a $0.12/unit special distribution for June (payable July 6, 2026), bringing the July total to $0.24/unit (~$4.6M). The special distribution was driven by no debt, no drilling plans, and strong cash flow. After the special, accumulated unpaid distributions total $2.083789/unit (~$39.5M). This is a routine capital distribution update, not a special situation event.
